content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Email Template Builder ## slug: email-template-builder-1 ## seoTitle: Email Template Builder ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The {{variable.Component_EmailTemplateBuilder}} is a user-friendly tool that creates great-looking email templates for your {{variable.Object_Event}}. Use the builder and our {{variable.Component_EmailConfiguration}} component to add custom email templates for * Confirmation emails, * Waitlist emails, and * Waitlist pending emails. *Note: If you are using the {{variable.Component_EmailConfiguration}} component to set up emails on a per {{variable.Object_Event}} basis, you will need to disable the corresponding workflow rule. Or the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s will receive both emails! Click {{variable.Button_CreateEmailTemplates}} to create our out-of-the-box email templates. ![Create Email Templates Button](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Email%20Templates%20Button.png){height="" width=""} For more information about using email templates, click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/email-management-event-invites-reminders-more). Please give users who need to access to the Blackthorn {{variable.Component_EmailTemplateBuilder}} these instructions: [Email Template Builder](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/email-template-builder){target="_blank"}. ## Did you receive a refused to connect error? If you receive a refused to connect error (i.e., 'domain.csxyz.visual.force.com refused to connect') when using the builder to create an email template, you must allowlist a couple of domains in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. ## How to Allowlist a Domain 1. Go to Setup. 2. Search for and go to “Session Settings.” 3. Allowlist these domains for Visualforce Pages: * lightning.force.com (http://lightning.force.com/) * my.salesforce.com (http://my.salesforce.com/)
